svg.title: The seven question types of LongMemEval
svg.desc: The paper's Figure 1: one example for each of LongMemEval's seven question types, each with the user's statements on the left and the question and answer on the right. Single-session-user: a 45-minute commute. Single-session-assistant: the restaurant the assistant recommended. Single-session-preference: Sony camera accessories. Temporal reasoning: months since a museum visit. Multi-session: how many instruments the user owns. Abstention: a 30-gallon tank never mentioned. Knowledge update, outlined: a family trip to Hawaii, then a later trip to Paris; the most recent family trip is Paris. Only knowledge-update questions are used in this experiment.
svg.text: The seven question types of LongMemEval
One example of each type, from the paper. This experiment uses only the knowledge-update questions (outlined): a fact
the user states and later changes.
The outline is added; the figure is otherwise as published.
Figure 1 of Wu et al., LongMemEval (ICLR 2025), CC BY 4.0
